messages:
maria (People Ops): heads up — we have a group of 7 visitors checking in at 2pm for a partner demo. Front desk says there's a huge box of swag in the lobby labelled 'ACME PARTNER KITS' but no pickup name. can someone confirm who to badge and where to stash the box? :package:

oliver (Front Desk): courier left it on the bench at 12:15, no signature. i put it inside the glass room for now. box is heavy and a little wet on one corner. i left a sticky saying 'needs owner' on it.

sam (Eng): if it's demo swag we can put it in the conference room A cart. do we need to pre-badge visitors? i can stand by the lobby at 1:50 if needed.

jules (Office Ops): pls don't leave it in CR A overnight — we have all-hands tomorrow. i'll move it to the secure closet (by the printers) in 10. need the pickup list though. maria — can you confirm names?

maria (People Ops): @tess can you check your calendar/comms? partner sent invite earlier. also whoever's hosting, DM me the guest emails and i'll pre-print badges.

tess (Design): oh yep that was ours — i asked for 5 extra kits for the demo run-through. forgot to leave host name for courier. sorry! names: jordan@acme, priya@acme, lee@acme, alex@acme, samir@acme, plus 2 walk-ins. badge labels should be: GUEST - ACME.

jules (Office Ops): thanks @tess. moving box to secure closet now. will label with names and open to check for fragile items. please confirm if any dietary restrictions — there are also 2 snack tins in there that look like cookies. :cookie:

sam (Eng): quick Q — seating for 7 in lounge? can we pull the tall stools from the kitchen island and add folding chairs by the couches? don't want them hogging desks.

maria (People Ops): yes — set lounge + 3 folding chairs by the couch. @jules can you confirm setup complete by 1:40?

jules (Office Ops): will do. also sharing small checklist: 1) badges preprinted 2) box inventoried 3) secure closet -> host 4) seating arranged 5) courier note added. i'll post a photo when done.

oliver (Front Desk): added note on courier log: 'ACME PARTNER KITS left without contact — moved to secure closet at 12:30'. cc @security.

tess (Design): thanks team! if anyone wants popcorn for the demo run-through, i'm bringing a bag at 1:30 — first come first served. :popcorn:

maria (People Ops): love this. small ask — can host email guests with a 15-min buffer to use front-desk buzzer? some vendors get confused. i'll add that to the calendar invite. :thumbsup:

sam (Eng): i can help with baggage / heavy lifting at 1:35 if needed.

jules (Office Ops): all set — photos attached in thread (uploaded). badges printed, seating ready, box inventoried (5 kits + 2 snack tins). moving leftover cardboard to recycling. see you at 1:40. :white_check_mark:
